resources.string: Public X/Twitter metadata fallback\nIf normal extraction encounters certain unavailable public-post metadata, MediaFlow may ask FxTwitter, an independent service at api.fxtwitter.com, for metadata using the public post ID. This exposes that ID and normal connection information, such as your IP address, to that service. This fallback is skipped when signed in to X; it does not forward X login cookies or credentials. It cannot unlock private or deleted posts, and depends on the service’s availability and privacy practices.

Accounts and connections
MediaFlow has no app account, advertising or analytics service. Analyzing links, downloading media and loading remote artwork sends requests to the source websites and their delivery services. Those services receive connection information such as your IP address, requested URL and necessary request headers. Your configured network, proxy or VPN also handles this traffic.

Data on your device
The app stores download history, source links, selected formats, settings, temporary files and limited technical diagnostics in app-private storage. Source-provided cookies or session headers may be retained with download plans for transfer and recovery. Removing a history entry does not delete its saved media file. Deleting a saved file from the Library requires confirmation.

WhatsApp statuses
Status Saver reads only media available through folder or file access you grant. It does not read chats, contacts or WhatsApp login credentials, and does not upload status media. Saving happens only when you choose Save. Folder observation runs while the status screen is active and refreshes when you return; it is not continuous background archiving.

Saved files and document providers
Copies saved to Gallery or a selected destination are outside the app’s private database. Their visibility and retention depend on Android permissions and the selected provider. A third-party or cloud document provider may use its own network service and privacy practices.

Permissions and control
Notification permission is optional. You can disconnect a status folder or clear selected imports in Status Saver, and manage permissions in Android settings. Android backup is disabled in the app manifest. Uninstalling removes app-private data; published media copies may remain in shared storage or the selected provider.

Third-party services
MediaFlow does not operate a media-upload backend. Websites, Android services and document providers you use have their own privacy practices.
